items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: I could remember fellas like Buddy Petit and Sam Organ, old Sam Organ

ctx.x: But of course I would consider myself at that time not too much of a good judge of music or talent because I didn't know too much about it. But I could remember fellas like Buddy Petit and Sam Organ, old Sam Organ, and Chris Kelly, Kid Renee, and matter of fact I worked with Kid Renee for a while when they first opened up the New Gypsy Tea Room in 1932. Oh yeah, there on St. Philip and St. Philip.
In 1932. When they first opened up there I worked with him.
